about: The spin-drum carrier. Her layout is split into the files named in `layout` (each holds the top-level entries listed), joined at load in this order (src/core/ship.mjs `loadLayout`, tools/blender/shipkit.py `load_layout`). tools/carrier-v2.mjs writes them from design/carrier-v2.design.json: do not edit them by hand. Beside them, the ship's career (career.json), routine (watches.json) and cast (voices.json), which are written by hand.
